pages.text: The remote upgrades provide an alternative way of connecting drawers to a controller network.$(p)Drawers with a remote upgrade can connect 'wirelessly' to a network as long as they are still within range of the controller.

The singular variant of the upgrade will connect the single drawer that has the upgrade.$(p)The group variant will connect the drawer as well as any other drawers that have a connected path to it.$(p)Any existing singular variant can be upgraded to the group variant by crafting it with two ender pearls.

Before using any variant of remote upgrade, it must first be 'bound' to a controller, by using the item directly on a controller block like a tool.$(p)If the controller is broken, the upgrade will lose its binding.$(p)An upgrade can be re-bound at any time by using it on another controller.

A bound remote upgrade item can also be used on other drawer blocks that already have a remote upgrade, which will rebind those drawers without needing to remove the upgrade.$(p)This can be helpful if the drawers ever lose their binding.
